title: Continents and oceans
examples: How many continents are there on Earth?
Can you name all the continents for me?

explain.say: The Earth has big areas of land and big areas of salt water.
The big areas of land are called continents. There are seven continents.
They are Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia.
The big areas of salt water are called oceans. There are five oceans.
They are the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic Oceans.
Asia is the biggest continent. The Pacific is the biggest ocean. The Arctic is the smallest ocean.

draw.text: Biggest: Asia and the Pacific. Smallest ocean: Arctic.

explain.say: Ireland is in Europe. The Atlantic Ocean is next to Ireland.

asks: Tell me about Australia's land status.

faq.q: Are continents all the same size?
faq.a: No, the continents are very different in size. Asia is the largest continent, and Australia is much smaller.
asks: Do all continents have the same size?
Compare the sizes of the continents.

facts: There are seven continents on Earth.
The five oceans are Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, and Arctic.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean.
Antarctica is known for being the coldest continent.

quiz.say: Look at the seven continents. Tap the biggest one.
quiz.why: Asia is the biggest continent. It has the most land and the most people.

wrong.0: Africa is the second biggest continent, and Asia is bigger.
wrong.2: Antarctica looks big on some maps, but Asia has more land.

quiz.why: The Arctic Ocean is the smallest ocean. It is near the North Pole.

wrong.0: The Atlantic Ocean is the second biggest ocean.
wrong.1: The Indian Ocean is the third biggest ocean.

quiz.say: Look at a world map. Tap the biggest ocean.
quiz.why: The Pacific Ocean is the biggest ocean. It is bigger than all the land on Earth put together.

wrong.1: The Atlantic Ocean is the second biggest ocean.
